g.title: crate Three-lane Task Board app with context, keyed lists and a saving queue.
crate::components::app Root component of the Task Board: loads the saved board, then mounts it.
crate::components::board The Task Board's board: shared state, add form, editor, lanes and saving.
crate::components::lane One lane: a filtered, virtualized list of task cards.
crate::components::search Search field that filters every lane by title or notes.
crate::components::task_editor Editor of the selected task (mounted by `show_some` while one is selected).
crate::model Board data model (lanes and tasks) and its JSON form.
crate::platform Platform differences of the board storage.
crate::storage Loading and saving the board as a JSON file.
